role: Template for the cross-implementation validation report: fixed prose (method, interpretation, limitations, white-paper notes, reproduction commands) with {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens that make_results.py replaces with generated tables. Section 1 states that the PSG agreement numbers predate the per-window gap fix in the classifier and its port and have not been re-run.
toplevel: Markdown; placeholders PORT_TABLE, SLEEP_OVERALL, SLPDB_PERREC_KAPPA, CAP_PERREC_KAPPA, SLEEP_CM5, SLEEP_CM30, SLEEP_CLASS, SLEEP_MIN, SLEEP_PER_RECORD, SLEEP_CAP_CM5, SLEEP_CAP_PER_RECORD, ART_N, ART_DET, ART_SYM, ART_RMSSD, DFA_N, DFA_TABLE, DFA_FC. Interpretation figures are typed in by hand and were checked against the committed RESULTS.md tables (e.g. kappa 0.072/0.146, deep 31 % vs 6.4 %, ArtifactDetector 57.5 %/94.9 %/71 %, 44 % withheld at 3 % ectopic = 100-56 %, 21.6 %/7.3 % false corrections): they agree.

flags.text: Reproducing section documents `fetch_physionet.py <db> 1.0.0 <DATA_ROOT>/<db> RECORDS <files...>` correctly, but fetch_physionet.py's own docstring describes an automatic no-file mode and --ext option that do not exist.
